summary: This bill directs the United States Trade Representative to advocate for Canada and Mexico to implement foreign investment review frameworks similar to the U.S. system and establish a coordination mechanism among the three countries to address national security risks from foreign investments during the next joint review under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement.
